items.name: My reaction
items.what: Creators pick a topic from their niche and give their honest opinion or ranking using only facial expressions.

items.name: Getting robbed
items.what: Creators film a single-shot video of themselves glued to their phone while someone steals their bag in the background, showcasing what would distract them.

items.name: October is all about me
items.what: Creators pair Drake's line 'October is all about me' with on-screen text and a simple video to highlight their main character energy.

items.name: Text message from -A
items.what: Creators share a text-on-screen hook that ends with '-A' paired with Pretty Little Liars audio to show that 'A' is watching.

items.name: I just want to be OK
items.what: Creators appear carefree on screen while text overlay names something they are secretly spiraling or anxious about.

items.name: Upside down
items.what: Creators mouth lyrics and perform hand gestures before utilizing a transition to reveal a dramatic before-and-after.

items.name: Some people call me...
items.what: Creators flip common nicknames into a sales pitch by starting with what people call them and ending on what they should be called for their specialty.

items.name: Once a day, once a week, once a month
items.what: Creators break down their habits, routines, or schedules into daily, weekly, and monthly timeframes.

items.name: Manifesting
items.what: Creators overlay visuals of their dream life with Dua Lipa's 'Training Season' to express positive goals and intentions.
